summary: Implemented the window title feature without running any tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title (gated only on is_terminal, returns bool, with the required docstring); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests were appended to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. The console test returns early on legacy Windows instead of using pytest.skip. Tests were not executed, so pass/fail status is unverified.
